fields.Name: Plurality
fields.Description: Top-N candidates or options win based on most votes received

fields.Name: Majority
fields.Description: Candidate or option must exceed a specified threshold (typically over 50% of votes cast or eligible voters)

fields.Name: Approval
fields.Description: Voters approve multiple candidates or options; top-N approved options win

fields.Name: Instant Runoff (IRV)
fields.Description: Ranked choice voting for single-seat contests with successive elimination

fields.Name: Single Transferable Vote (STV)
fields.Description: Ranked choice voting for multi-seat contests using Scottish STV with Weighted Inclusive Gregory Method and Droop quota
